summary: Short clearway kerb on Moggill Road; main lane, no parking, no room.

drivers.seclusion: Shops 20 m away on the same side; open to view.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is on the through lane by a median-style island; no bay.
drivers.convention: Clearway Mon-Sat 4-7 pm, tow away; no cars parked here.

sun_shade: Open to sun; a few trees on the corner.
